seo.title: Activities & Experiences | Ilala Lodge Hotel Victoria Falls
seo.description: Adventure, wildlife, relaxation and culture at Victoria Falls. From rafting and helicopter flights to game drives, river cruises and high tea — all bookable through the Activities Desk at Ilala Lodge Hotel.

page_sections.heading: Victoria Falls Activities
page_sections.body:
Victoria Falls is one of Africa's leading destinations for adventure, wildlife, and culture, and Ilala Lodge Hotel is ideally positioned to experience it all.

From the Zambezi River to the surrounding national parks, the region offers a wide range of experiences to suit every pace of travel. Our Activities Desk is available to assist with planning and booking, including transfers and cross-border excursions.

Among the most popular experiences are Zambezi River cruises, helicopter flights over the Falls, Chobe Day Trips, and guided game drives — each offering a different perspective of this remarkable destination.

page_sections.eyebrow: A slower pace on the Zambezi
page_sections.heading: Relaxation
page_sections.subheading: River cruises at sunrise, over lunch, or at sunset allow guests to take in the landscape at leisure. Smaller, more intimate cruise options offer a quieter setting still — see the Featured Experiences below for riverside dining and high tea.

cards.title: Sunrise River Cruise
cards.description: Begin the day on the Zambezi River as the sun rises, with tea, coffee, and pastries served on board while the bush comes alive around you.

cards.title: Sunset Cruise
cards.description: Drift along the Upper Zambezi as the sun sets, with drinks and snacks served on board.

cards.title: Lunch Cruise
cards.description: A leisurely cruise over lunch, taking in the river at a relaxed pace.

cards.title: Intimate Cruises
cards.description: Private or small-group cruises on the Zambezi for a more exclusive experience, ideal for special occasions or those seeking a quieter setting.

page_sections.heading: Wildlife
page_sections.subheading: The area surrounding Victoria Falls is rich in wildlife, with opportunities for both short excursions and full-day safaris. Game drives, cross-border trips to Chobe and Hwange, and Zambezi cruises each open up a different angle on the region's wildlife.

cards.title: Game Drives
cards.description: Morning, afternoon, or evening drives in nearby national parks — opportunities for both short excursions and full-day safaris.

cards.title: Chobe & Hwange National Parks
cards.description: Day trips into Botswana to Chobe National Park, home to one of Africa's densest elephant populations, or extended trips for exceptional game viewing in Zimbabwe's largest national park, Hwange, within 100km of the hotel.

cards.title: Walk with Elephants
cards.description: An unforgettable opportunity to walk alongside these gentle giants, learning about their behaviour and conservation in a natural setting.

cards.title: Cruises on the Zambezi River
cards.description: Wildlife often seen along the riverbanks during cruises and other water-based activities, with opportunities to spot hippos, crocodiles, and diverse birdlife.

page_sections.heading: Cultural
page_sections.subheading: Cultural experiences that provide insight into local life and traditions — from guided rainforest tours and village visits to township dining and traditional evening performances.

cards.title: Curio Shopping
cards.description: Browse local crafts, artwork, and souvenirs at markets and shops throughout Victoria Falls.

cards.title: Traditional Dining & Performances
cards.description: Evening experiences combining traditional dinners with music and dance.

cards.title: Township Dining
cards.description: An introduction to the region's communities through shared meals at Dusty Road Township.

cards.title: Rainforest Tour
cards.description: A guided walk through the Victoria Falls rainforest, exploring its unique ecosystem and the heritage of the region.

page_sections.heading: Adventure
page_sections.subheading: High-adrenaline experiences set against a dramatic natural backdrop — from white-water rafting on the Zambezi to bungee, gorge swings, zip lines, helicopter flights, and canopy tours.

cards.title: White Water Rafting
cards.description: Navigate the Zambezi's Grade 5 rapids — a world-class rafting experience and a Victoria Falls standout.

cards.title: Bungee Jumping & Gorge Swing
cards.description: Take the leap from the Victoria Falls Bridge — one of the world's highest commercial bungee jumps at 111 metres — or experience a 70-metre free fall followed by a swing across the Batoka Gorge.

cards.title: Zip Lining
cards.description: Soar across the Batoka Gorge on a high-speed zip line, taking in dramatic views of the gorge below.

cards.title: Helicopter Flights
cards.description: The Flight of Angels offers sweeping aerial views of the Falls and surrounding landscape — among the most popular ways to take in the scale of the region.

page_sections.heading: High Tea Experience
page_sections.body:
Enjoy High Tea at Palm River Hotel on the banks of the Zambezi River. Set beneath indigenous trees, this riverside experience offers a relaxed setting to enjoy a selection of sweet and savoury treats. Advanced reservations are essential.

Contact: fnb@palmriverhotel.com

page_sections.heading: Zambezi River Deck Experience
page_sections.body:
An African-style barbecue dinner beside the Zambezi River at Palm River Hotel. The three-course menu includes locally sourced options such as crocodile and kudu, prepared over open coals. Dine outdoors in a lantern-lit riverside setting.

Contact: fnb@palmriverhotel.com

page_sections.heading: Ra-Ikane River Cruise
page_sections.body: Explore the Zambezi River aboard the Ra-Ikane, inspired by the journeys of David Livingstone. With a maximum of 24 guests, the cruise offers a more intimate setting to view birdlife and wildlife along the river and surrounding islands.

page_sections.heading: Let Us Help Plan Your Perfect Experience
page_sections.body: Our Activities Desk can arrange every excursion, transfer, and cross-border trip — get in touch to start planning your stay.
